major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press on cooldown every 2 minutes inside your Voidform/Dark Ascension burst, syncing it with your on-use trinkets, potion and (where possible) Bloodlust.

major_cooldowns.name: Void Eruption
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast to enter Voidform and gain access to Void Volley; use it as consistently as possible so it keeps lining up with Power Infusion, Halo and Void Torrent. (Cooldown is a best-guess for Midnight - verify against logs.)

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Archon keystone - cast early in the opener and each burst window because its damage and proc generation ramp up slowly.

major_cooldowns.name: Void Torrent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Voidweaver tool - channel it to open Entropic Rift, then spend Void Blast inside the Rift window.

defensives.name: Dispersion
defensives.usage_rule: Press to reduce all damage taken by 75% during heavy raid hits or unavoidable burst, accepting the brief loss of offensive casts.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Use to instantly heal and raise your maximum health when you drop below ~75%, especially after Shadow Word: Death self-damage.

defensives.name: Vampiric Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Activate during periods of sustained raid damage to convert your Shadow damage into self and raid healing.

rules.action: Press Power Infusion together with Void Eruption so your haste buff and Voidform burst overlap every 2 minutes.

rules.description: Open with Tentacle Slam then burst cooldowns
rules.action: Pre-cast Tentacle Slam, then on pull fire Halo (Archon) or Void Torrent (Voidweaver) alongside Power Infusion and your on-use trinkets and potion.
Maintain Vampiric Touch on the primary target at all times to keep Mastery: Shadow Weaving ramped, refreshing it with Tentacle Slam or a hardcast before it expires.
Cast Void Eruption as soon as it is available so it stays aligned with Power Infusion, Halo and Void Torrent across the fight.

rules.description: Cast Halo early in each window (Archon)
rules.action: As Archon, use Halo at the start of your opener and every burst window so its slow-ramping damage and proc generation have time to pay off.
As Voidweaver, cast Void Torrent to open Entropic Rift, then spend Void Blast and Shadow Word: Madness inside the Rift window.
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness before you hit 100 so you never waste resource generation.

rules.description: Sync trinkets and potion with Power Infusion
rules.action: Hold your on-use trinkets and damage potion for the Power Infusion / Voidform window so their value overlaps your haste burst.

rules.description: Drop Mind Blast and Void Bolt at high target counts
rules.action: At 5 or more targets stop hardcasting Mind Blast, and at 10 or more targets stop using Void Bolt except for movement, since both become a damage and Insanity loss.

source_summary: Shadow Priest in Midnight stacks a 2-minute burst built on Power Infusion synced with Voidform (Void Eruption), layering Halo for Archon or Void Torrent / Entropic Rift for Voidweaver, plus on-use trinkets and potion. Outside of burst the spec keeps Vampiric Touch up for Mastery: Shadow Weaving, spends Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness without overcapping, and uses every cooldown on cooldown to avoid losing casts. Dispersion and Desperate Prayer cover personal survival.
